summary: You score five golden questions by hand in a table, then write a script from a contract that prints the expected page, the three retrieved pages, the rank, the refusal and the result, with hit@3, MRR and refusal accuracy. You compare hand and script, because a disagreement is a bug in one of them.
goal: Score 5 questions by hand, then by script, from a blank file.

items.text: Write down how many of the five will pass and which is most likely to fail
Score the five questions by hand and fill in the table
Write score_by_script.py from the contract, without the solution
Compare hand and script row by row and find any bug
Play the Score It game to the end and see your score
